summary: Alphabet Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $40 billion in Class A common stock (GOOGL) and Class C capital stock (GOOG). The shares will be sold through agents Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, and Morgan Stanley at prevailing market prices, with a 0.5% commission. Proceeds are primarily to manage tax obligations from employee equity vesting and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital markets activity, not a special situation, as it involves ordinary share issuance without any acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other event-driven corporate action.
